source.section: Schedule 2 line 11 code 601 and PDF pages 19-20 Civil Service Annuity Deduction (PDF page 19: 'The lesser of the amount of taxable civil service annuity income ... or $16,000, Less all amounts of Social Security income and tier 1 and tier 2 Railroad Retirement income ... received by the civil service annuitant'), with its examples (PDF page 20: Matthew, Social Security over the annuity, no deduction); Schedule 2 line 5 (PDF page 17 Lines 5 and 6); Schedule 3 line 1 (PDF page 24: joint 2,000, all other filers 1,000), line 4 (PDF page 25: 1,000 age 65 or older), line 5 (PDF page 25: 500 age 65 or older and IT-40 line 1 under 40,000, or under 20,000 married filing separately); Form IT-40 lines 1-8 (PDF page 1; line 8 'multiply line 7 by 3% (.03)'); booklet PDF page 8 Line 1; PDF pages 5-6 rounding

worked: Federal AGI = federal civil service annuity person 0 10,000.00 + IRA distribution person 0 25,000.00 + taxable Social Security 8,500.00 = 43,500.00. Social Security received: person 0 10,000.00; the federal taxable amount from the federal worksheet is 8,500.00. Federal taxable income = 43,500.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 age 65 additional = 25,750.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Indiana starts from federal AGI). Form IT-40 line 1 federal AGI 43,500.00. Line 2 add-backs 0.00; line 3 = 43,500.00 + 0.00 = 43,500.00. Civil service annuity person 0 (age 66): lesser of the taxable annuity 10,000.00 and 16,000.00 = 10,000.00; less that person's own Social Security received 10,000.00 (the gross amount, not the taxable 8,500.00) and railroad retirement 0.00 = 0.00. Taking the Social Security off the 16,000.00 first would leave 6,000.00; the booklet takes it off the lesser amount. Schedule 2: line 5 taxable Social Security 8,500.00; line 11 code 601 civil service annuity 0.00; line 12 total = 8,500.00. IT-40 line 4 = 8,500.00. Line 5 = 43,500.00 - 8,500.00 = 35,000.00. Schedule 3: line 1 1,000.00; line 4 1 x 1,000.00 = 1,000.00; line 5 IT-40 line 1 43,500.00 is not less than 40,000.00: none; line 7 total = 2,000.00. IT-40 line 6 = 2,000.00. Line 7 = 35,000.00 - 2,000.00 = 33,000.00. Line 8 = 33,000.00 x 0.03 = 990.00. No credits; county tax (line 9) is local and out of scope. State income tax 990.00.
